# Reports
{: .no_toc }

Growth, access, usage, subscribers and delivery over time.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

This screen is part of the **web Hub's Console** and isn't in the Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS or Android apps yet (specs OPEN-QUESTIONS #27).
{: .note }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `RPT-01` |
| **Route** | `/admin/reports` |
| **Where** | Administration › Reports |
| **Who can use it** | users.list (platform reports); an Application owner sees only their own app |
| **Kind** | detail |
| **Available in** | Web Hub only (Console M4 (web only)) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Report | select | platform growth · access · usage · subscribers · delivery | subscribers needs [G20 #57](https://github.com/CompositeCode/substratalapps.com/issues/57) |
| Range | date range |  | in the URL |
| Chart + table | chart, table | the report's series | accessible table view |
| Export | button | CSV of the loaded series | client-side |

## Good to know

- Revenue stays in Stripe; link to the Stripe dashboard instead of mirroring it.

## For developers

Loads: after [G7 #44](https://github.com/CompositeCode/substratalapps.com/issues/44): `GET /usage` · `GET /stats`. Before: only reports small enough to build by paging list endpoints.

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
